name: Setco Automotive Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Setco Automotive Ltd manufactures Clutch products and systems and Hydraulics (Pressure Converters)[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SAL is the flagship company of The Setco Group, which also includes Lava Cast Pvt. Ltd, and its CSR wing, the Setco Foundation, promoted by the Sheth Family. The company is a Tier I supplier clutches for commercial vehicles, for hydraulic products for the construction equipment industry and precision engineering components

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 94.6% of their holding.
Debtor days have increased from 29.2 to 36.6 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
